measuredEffect.note: The amd64 live CD boot log shows winlogon assigning a startup desktop and the shell extensions running, with no bugcheck. That boot does not create a file on an NTFS volume, so the new attribute length was not read back. The driver writes 72 bytes when the mounted volume's major version is 3 or newer, and 48 otherwise.

note: No Linux driver source was copied. The 72-byte field order matches the offsets ntfslib's MkStdInfo already writes.
